settings.reason: One trade a day: the first breakout of the day is most often a morning one, the best part (tables.md, half width, 9:30 AM band, half hour, morning, both sides: 370 breakouts, 38.1% reach twice the risk, +0.49 held to 4 PM), and one trade a day caps the day's loss at one stop. Whole-day window kept because the morning alone has a 10-day stretch.
